Question: Can you please tell me which kitab or kitabs will have Ibn Ishaq's and musa bin Uqba's riwaayat of the names of ashabe badr? Answer ID: 22489 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 998/745/L=1431) The detail of participants of Badr is written in Maghazi ibn Ishaq and Maghazi Musa ibn Uqba. Hafiz ibn Hajar Asqalani and the author of Al-Bidaya O Al-Nihaya have fixed the number of Badri sahaba accordingly. The detail can be seen in Siraat Ibn Hisham. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
